items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Well, then, of course, Benny -- Bartok wrote for Benny and I mean, that was a serious step for Benny to try to move into that, wasn't it?

ctx.x: Benny Goodman and Tommy Dorsey were the kinds of guys, you know, worked on their horns all the time and there was no -- with all their success, they tried to go on and play better.
Well, then, of course, Benny -- Bartok wrote for Benny and I mean, that was a serious step for Benny to try to move into that, wasn't it?

Well, I wondered, because, you see, his background was that. They don't know, they think of Benny Goodman has having been a jazz dance band clarinet player, but Benny Goodman was schooled in symphonic music.
